design_vision: PropIQ fuses botanical warmth with architectural precision. It aims to deliver a 'modern banking' feel that builds trust without the coldness of typical fintech dark modes. We will use a soft bone-white base with deep forest green accents to represent growth and stability.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Use p-6 or p-8 for containers to ensure generous breathing room

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-stone-200 for grounded tactical feel

components.button: rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-all duration-200 active:scale-95 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#1C3F35]/50 focus:outline-none
components.card: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 p-6 flex flex-col gap-4 relative overflow-hidden
components.input: bg-white border border-stone-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:border-[#1C3F35] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#1C3F35] outline-none transition-all
components.header: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-stone-200 sticky top-0 z-50

charts.style: Clean, minimal grid lines, tooltip must have sharp 1px border. Use Recharts or Shadcn charts.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA standards. Provide specific hover text colors to prevent inheritance issues.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='add-property-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Load 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' via Google Fonts. Use Outfit for all headings and Manrope for body text.
Implement the layout with mobile-first principles. Ensure all images are constrained to max-h-[80vh] on mobile.
Do not use transparent headers over content; use backdrop-blur glassmorphism.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for structural bento grid layouts, but rely on customized Shadcn primitives for complex interactions like dialogs, tables, and dropdowns.
For the charts (bar, line, pie), use Shadcn chart components or Recharts with the specified earthy color palette: deep green (#1C3F35), terracotta (#D36B4F), and soft yellows/grays.
Integrate Lucide React for iconography. Maintain a 1.5px stroke width.
Ensure padding and touch targets are generous (min 44px for buttons) to support a hybrid mobile feel.
Avoid generic 'fintech blue'. Stick rigorously to the warm stone and forest green palette.
Include 'data-testid' on all buttons, forms, and key metric cards.
